newsitem.title: HONDURAS: At least 21 dead in Honduras bus crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 21 dead in Honduras bus crash.

text.p: At least 21 people were killed and 11 injured on Friday when a bus and truck collided in southern Honduras in one of the worst road accident in decades, police said.
"The final report we have is 21 dead and 11 hurt," Eduardo Oseguera, a lieutenant with the local fire department, told Reuters by telephone.
"The bodies were burned beyond recognition. They died trapped in the bus. The vehicle burst into flames in a minute," he said.
The accident took place in the southern province of Choluteca, in a sector known as Las Pavas, about 52 miles (85 km) south of the capital, Tegucigalpa.
Survivors were taken to nearby hospitals.
"The vehicles were smashed together so that we couldn't even recognise them," Jose Raudales, an eyewitness said.
